source_note: 自然数的r次幂的部分和估计
english_source_note: Partial Sum Estimates for Powers of Integers
callout_id: 自然数的r次幂的部分和估计#5
english_title: Inequality Form of the Summation for r > 1
statement_en:
If $r>1$, then
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-r}=\zeta(r)+\frac{1}{1-r} n^{1-r}+\frac{1}{2} n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12} n^{-r-1}+E_r(n),$$
where the remainder satisfies
$$|E_r(n)|<\frac{r(r+1)(r+2)}{720n^{r+3}}.$$
